detail.overview: Intex 75" Interactive Flat Panel The Intex IFPSL-7501/IFPSL-7502/IFPSL-7506/IFPSL-7507 75" Interactive Flat Panel combines cutting-edge technology with sleek design, offering a 4K Ultra HD IPS display for stunning visuals. Powered by Android 14, 8 GB RAM, and 128 GB storage, it ensures smooth performance for all tasks. With ultra-fine 20-point multi-touch capability, built-in 48 MP AI camera, and 8-microphone array, this panel is perfect for immersive collaboration. Seamless connectivity options, including HDMI, USB Type-C, and an optional OPS slot, make it ideal for classrooms, offices, and meeting rooms, delivering an unmatched interactive experience.
